about: Classes of mistake that the X3D object model (X3DUOM) itself lets us enumerate. Hand-chosen by the kernel editor on 28 November 2026 from the attributes the model carries, with no test set open. A class applies to a field or a node when the model's own attribute says so (the 'applies' line); nothing here is taken from a planted fault.

F01-range.mistake: the value is outside the range the standard states for the field
F01-range.applies: the field has minInclusive, maxInclusive, minExclusive or maxExclusive

F02-enumeration.mistake: the value is not one of the listed values
F02-enumeration.applies: the field lists enumeration values and does not allow additional ones

F03-child-type.mistake: the field holds a node of a type it does not accept

F04-route-to-non-input.mistake: a ROUTE ends at a field that takes no events

F05-route-from-non-output.mistake: a ROUTE starts at a field that sends no events

F06-route-type.mistake: a ROUTE joins the field to a field of another type
F06-route-type.applies: accessType is inputOnly, outputOnly or inputOutput

F07-index.mistake: an index points past the end of the array it indexes, or the -1 separators are wrong
F07-index.applies: the field is MFInt32 and its name ends in Index

F08-address.mistake: the address finds nothing, or finds a file of the wrong kind
F08-address.applies: the field is MFString and its name contains url

F09-time.mistake: time values under which the node never runs, never stops, or ran once in 1970
F09-time.applies: the field is SFTime and can be written (inputOutput or initializeOnly)

F10-switched-off.mistake: the node is switched off by this field and nothing ever switches it on
F10-switched-off.applies: the field is SFBool, can be written, and is named enabled, on, visible or load

N01-sensor-unheard.mistake: the sensor's outputs go nowhere, or the thing it should watch is not there

N02-parallel-arrays.mistake: key and keyValue disagree in length, or key does not rise
N02-parallel-arrays.applies: the node has both a key and a keyValue field

N03-bindable.mistake: the wrong one is bound first, or the one that matters is never bound

N04-def-use.mistake: USE of a DEF that is missing or of another node type, or a USE that carries its own fields

N05-component.mistake: the node is used although the profile and component statements do not include its component at its level

cell_states.unprobed: nobody has tested this cell yet
cell_states.xsd: the X3D 4.0 schema already refuses the mistake
cell_states.caught: a probe pair exists: the kernel names the mistake on the wrong file and is silent on the corrected one
cell_states.missed: a probe pair exists, the mistake can be stated from the file, and the kernel says nothing: open work
cell_states.needs-intent: the file is legal either way; only what the author meant decides
cell_states.not-a-mistake: the standard allows it and no browser we test behaves differently
